items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Tudi Tootie' (e.g., 'Who else was in that band, Tudi Tootie?'). The interviewee responds to questions about their own career and band members (Roy Palmer) but does not mention Tudi Tootie as a separate individual.

ctx.x: And he's sick now, and Freddie played, you see?
Uh-huh. Who else was in that band, Tudi Tootie? Your Chicago band.
I had Roy Palmer on the trombone.
